summary: CAE Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the launch of a consent and proxy solicitation to amend the indenture governing its $400 million 5.541% Series 1 Senior Unsecured Notes due June 12, 2028. The proposed amendment updates accounting-principles definitions tied to a potential IFRS-to-U.S. GAAP transition, applied retrospectively for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. Noteholders of record November 9, 2026 receive one vote per $1,000 principal; failing written-consent thresholds, a meeting is set for December 16, 2026 in Montreal. Consenting holders receive a $1.00 per $1,000 principal consent fee. Watch approval thresholds and quorum mechanics rather than equity risk-arb.
